sourcePositions.position: Says developers and public beta testers received a total of three betas; it does not say there was developer Beta 3.
Explicitly says there were two developer betas before the final release.

conflicts.resolution: Keep developer Betas 1 and 2 only. Preserve the three-beta wording as an ambiguous cross-channel aggregate; never convert it into developer Beta 3.

sourcePositions.position: Final-release lead says iOS 10.3.2 followed four betas.
Final-release report says five betas preceded the final version.

conflicts.resolution: Keep Beta 5. Three independent contemporary reports explicitly identify it on April 27; classify the later four-beta aggregate as a reporting error.
